prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Learn Desktop Controls", "Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open quick controls, change visibility, or trigger animations.", "Got It, Let's Play!", "Right click for menu • Double click to play • Drag to move"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion's details and seal the adoption bond.", "Certified Companion"]
2: ["Verify & Generate Pet", "Photo Compatibility Check", "Checking lighting and angles to guarantee your custom pet looks amazing.", "Looks Good, Build Pet", "Clear focus • Single pet in frame • Good lighting"]
3: []
4: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account to instantly restore your previously adopted pets and progress."]
5: ["Checking graphics renderer and multi-monitor setup for seamless desktop pet overlay...", "Display permission granted • Graphics overlay active • Taskbar dock ready"]
6: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "Pick an instant adoption pet or design your unique custom companion."]
7: ["Welcome Home! Starter Pack Unlocked", "Bonus Gift: Golden Crown Item Unlocked"]
8: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Pet", "Select a ready-to-play companion. You can always customize or add more friends later!"]
9: ["Play chime when ready"]
